result.summary: The application interface contains minor layout and content display issues, primarily regarding text truncation and incomplete card rendering.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card layout or decrease the font size for longer restaurant names to ensure the full name is displayed, or implement a marquee effect.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom of the screen appears incomplete as it lacks a title, rating, or delivery details and is partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant cards are rendered within the visible viewport bounds and include necessary descriptive metadata (title, ratings, etc.) for every card shown.
